    About Shiba Inu

    Shiba Inu is a dog-themed memecoin launched on Ethereum in 2020. Its ecosystem includes the ShibaSwap exchange and the Shibarium layer-2 network.

    Where this SHIB price comes from

    The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (SHIB-USD), Binance (SHIB/USDT) and Kraken (SHIB/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 589.25T SHIB (supply last updated November 8, 2026).
